changelog:
cargo-billing 1.1.0

- Expanded description to clarify skill triggers and use cases, with guidance on when to use alternative skills.
- Added `update-payment-method` command for managing payment cards via CLI.
- Improved onboarding and bootstrap instructions for new users.
- Updated help and usage examples, including clear CLI flags and common user questions.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
summary: Understand what Cargo is costing — remaining credits, usage broken down by workflow, connector, or agent, subscription state, and invoice history. Triggers: "how many credits do I have left", "what did that cost", "why is my bill so high", "am I about to run out", "will this fit in our budget", "show me my invoices", "how much have I spent this month", "what plan am I on", "what do I get for free", "how many free credits", "can I afford this run", "add a card", "update my payment method", "why was my card declined". Needs a token with admin access. Skip when: attributing spend to specific nodes or cutting a play cost — use cargo-diagnostics.
